politics-2018-hl-q1-c.scheme: SEC Politics and Society 2018, Higher Level marking scheme, p. 5 (paper-trail-corpus/markingschemes/2018/LC568ALP000EV.pdf)
politics-2018-hl-q1-c.why: The scheme prices (c)(i) at 2 marks and (c)(ii), (c)(iii) at 1 mark each in the margin column on each heading's baseline (PyMuPDF words at y 56, 129, 231); the text layer gives each price its own line and politics_author.readable() drops a line that is only a price, so the block kept the headings without them.

politics-2019-ol-q1-f.scheme: SEC Politics and Society 2019, Ordinary Level marking scheme, p. 5 (paper-trail-corpus/markingschemes/2019/LC568GLP000EV.pdf)
politics-2019-ol-q1-f.why: The scheme prices the named body at 2 marks and the explanation at 3 marks in the margin column on each heading's baseline (PyMuPDF words at y 447, 469); the text layer gives each price its own line and politics_author.readable() drops a line that is only a price.
